docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A Hungarian romance of the Ottoman court in the seventeenth century: an exiled Hungarian officer, the Sultan and a plot to seize the empire.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Mór Jókai (1825–1904), The Slaves of the Padishah (1852, Hungarian), translated by Robert Nisbet Bain (1854–1909), 1903. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
